title: Security Remote Field Service Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Location:** Kolkata (Work from Office)  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Domain:** SOC, Cybersecurity, Banking & Data Centre Operations

Job Summary

We are hiring a **SIEM & Splunk Administrator** to support Security Operations Center (SOC) functions for a Banking & Data Centre project. The role involves administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of the Splunk platform to ensure continuous log collection, security event monitoring, compliance, and operational availability.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform daily health checks of Splunk Services, Indexers, Search Heads, and Universal Forwarders.
* Monitor and validate log ingestion from security devices, servers, applications, databases, and network infrastructure.
* Review Splunk license utilization and ensure platform capacity management.
* Monitor forwarder connectivity and troubleshoot data collection issues.
* Review audit logs and validate scheduled searches, alerts, and correlation rules.
* Monitor disk utilization, index health, and platform performance.
* Investigate and resolve Splunk internal errors, search failures, and performance issues.
* Perform daily/weekly backup and restoration validation of Splunk configurations.
* Support SOC operations, threat monitoring, incident investigation, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain operational documentation and security reports.

Required Qualifications

* Regular **B.E./B.Tech** in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related Engineering discipline.
* Minimum **5 years of hands-on experience** in Splunk Administration, SIEM Operations, or SOC environments.
* Strong knowledge of Splunk Enterprise, Enterprise Security (ES), Universal Forwarders, Indexers, Search Heads, and Distributed Architecture.
* Experience with Linux/Unix administration, log management, cybersecurity monitoring, and incident response processes.
* Exposure to Banking, BFSI, Data Centre, SOC, or Critical Infrastructure environments is preferred.

Preferred Certifications

* Splunk Enterprise Certified Admin
* Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin
* Splunk Core Certified Power User
* CompTIA Security+
* EC-Council Certified SOC Analyst (CSA)
* CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) or CISSP (Preferred)

**Workplace type****:**

On-site Working

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: Tech Lead
description:
**Tech Lead**

**Department**: Information Technology**, Location**: Head office, Kolkata**, Reports to**: CEO**, Team**: IT Network / Hardware & Access Manager (IT Central Support under him) · Product Engineer ×4**, Dotted line**: Site IT Support at the sites — functional, through the IT Network / Hardware & Access Manager.

*Every process in the Company Master is to run on a system by 31 March 2027, mostly on Crystal’s own tools. The Tech Lead will own the IT function and every in-house tool: The tools stay up and correct, every release is safe, and the knowledge to run them sits in documentation, not in one developer’s head.*

**Responsibilities:**

*Run the function*

* The request queue is prioritised weekly with each tool owner; every feature, change and bug sits in a release — nothing reaches a developer directly,
* P1 and P2 turnaround times are published and met; every bug and integration failure is closed with its cause,
* Every integration is listed with an owner and a developer,
* No release reaches production without the tool owner’s sign-off, updated documentation and a rollback plan; only the Tech Lead deploys,
* Every in-house tool outage is owned until restored, root cause logged within 3 days; any cyber incident reaches the CEO the same day.

*The 31 March build*

* Every process on the Implementation List runs on a system by 31 March 2027; build vs plan reaches the Program Lead and CEO weekly,
* Sprints run every two weeks on developer estimates, process engine first, each piloted at one large and one small site,
* The process engine has an owner and backup developer, a configuration backlog and a published turnaround once a process is signed,
* Every build runs from the Master’s spec — governance tracker entry, second-developer code review, owner test sign-off, signed handover,
* No control — checker, approval, gate — is released without a test that tries to bypass it; every merge touching a control is reviewed,
* Every need is assessed build vs buy — process engine, then a tool, then buy — with at least two options compared for the CEO.

*Service to sites and functions*

* Legacy data is cleaned, loaded and checked by the tool owner at each go-live; developers give first-line app support through each support window,
* Each tool is IT-ready before go-live — users trained by the Training & Content Specialist, access loaded by the IT Network Manager,
* Usage per tool per site is reported monthly from system logs, with workarounds seen; gaps reach the owning function head,
* IT sets the standard, tools and calendar for Site IT Support at every site and co-rates them with the Site Lead.

*Security, data and audit*

* The security standard — patching, firewall, incident response — is set and reviewed yearly; the IT Network Manager runs it,
* Cloud admin accounts are named with 2FA; no configuration change takes effect without a ticket and a backup before and after,
* The backup and restore standard is set; the half-yearly restore drill result reaches the CEO with gaps and dates,
* The held processes start once the seat is filled: external IT and cyber audit reporting to the CEO, data retention, personal-data protection with Legal.

*Money, vendors and assets*

* The IT budget — devices, links, cloud, licences, AMCs, contract developers — is built with the IT Network Manager and spend explained monthly,
* Contract developers work to the code policy — company GitHub only, no keys in code, coding tools on company accounts,
* All code, documentation and cloud accounts sit on company accounts, never personal ones.

*Knowledge and review*

* Every tool has an owner and backup developer and passes the quarterly pick-up test from its pack alone; gaps close within two weeks,
* The one-page IT pack goes out in the first week of each month for the CEO’s IT review; actions are logged with owners and dates,
* One measurable IT improvement is delivered each quarter, chosen from the IT review.

*Leading the team*

* Every team member knows their role card, monthly targets and priorities; the weekly team review is held as set in the Meetings Master,
* Each direct report has a monthly one-on-one — progress, honest feedback, help where stuck,
* Performance is reviewed on the PMS calendar, on evidence; weak performance gets an improvement plan early, not at appraisal,
* Every direct report has a development plan that is worked on — coaching on the job, training, stretch work,
* Strong performers are recognised and kept; every critical seat, including this one, has a ready backup,
* Open seats are filled with HR and new joiners inducted well; attendance, conduct and discipline are handled fairly and on time.

Pay: Up to ₹2,400,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What IT product and tool you have built personally, not by your team, only by you?
* Which warehouse or logistics operations have you built tools for?
* Walk me through the most complex tool you personally built from scratch. What did you write yourself — code, scripts, data model — and on what stack?
* Take one tool you built for operations. How did you gather the requirements, what architecture did you choose — front end, database, integrations, user access — and why?
* How big was the development team you managed and what were their roles? How did you run a typical week — planning, task assignment, code review, releases?
* What is your Current CTC per annum?
* What is your Expected CTC per annum?
* What is your Notice Period?

Work Location: In person

title: Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist
description:
**Position Overview:** As our Founding IT Systems, ***Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist***, you will wear multiple hats to own, scale, and secure our entire operational footprint. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day corporate IT logistics and high-performance GPU computing.

In this role, you will balance tracking high-value physical and software assets with deep hands-on infrastructure tasks like configuring network fabrics, tuning Linux kernels, and ensuring our core GPU stacks run at maximum utilization. This is an autonomous role built for a highly organized, technical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Asset Management, Procurement & Logistics (35%)**

* **Hardware Lifecycle Management:** Track, audit, and manage the full lifecycle of high-value physical hardware, including GPU server nodes, development laptops, switches, and peripheral accessories.
* **Vendor & RMA Logistics:** Own vendor relationships, negotiate procurement pricing, handle international/domestic shipping logistics, and manage RMA processes for faulty hardware component replacements.
* **SaaS & License Governance:** Audit and optimize enterprise software usage (e.g., Slack, GitHub, IDE licenses, Cloud compute credits) to eliminate cost inefficiencies and maximize seats.
* **Compliance & Inventory Audits:** Maintain precise infrastructure inventories and hardware asset registers, preparing the company for imminent security compliance benchmarks (such as SOC 2 Readiness).

**Startup IT & Network Operations (35%)**

* **Identity & Access Control:** Provision, manage, and deprovision secure user access frameworks across Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft 365, and localized SSH keys.
* **Office & Lab Networking:** Set up, secure, and monitor office/lab local networks, managing Wi-Fi access points, physical routers, firewalls, and reliable VPN networks for remote engineers.
* **Device Deployment:** Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

**GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)**

* **GPU Environment Isolation:** Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:** Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.
* **Telemetry & Alerts:** Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* **The Ultimate Generalist:** 3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.
* **Linux Proficiency:** High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:** Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:** Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:** Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).
* Experience configuring shared clusters via lightweight job schedulers (such as Slurm)

Application Question(s):

* We're operational from Kolkata, WB. Are you comfortable working in-person for the same?

Experience:

* Ubuntu: 3 years (Required)
* Windows: 3 years (Required)
* MacOS: 3 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)
* Hindi (Required)
* Bengali (Preferred)

title: Electrical Supervisor
description:
Job Description: Electrical Engineer

**Department:** Engineering / Technical Operations  
**Location:** Kolkata  
**Experience:** 3–4 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Electrical Technician/Engineer with hands-on experience in electrical troubleshooting, welding, equipment installation, and IP configuration of industrial devices. The ideal candidate should be capable of diagnosing technical faults, performing maintenance activities, and supporting the installation and configuration of electrical and network-connected equipment.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform electrical troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, and corrective maintenance.
* Install, inspect, and maintain electrical equipment, wiring, and related systems.
* Carry out basic welding and fabrication work as required.
* Configure IP addresses and network settings for industrial devices, controllers, and other network-enabled equipment.
* Assist with the installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of electrical systems.
* Identify technical issues and implement effective solutions to minimize downtime.
* Read and interpret electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate with engineering and field teams to complete assigned projects on time.
* Maintain service reports, maintenance records, and technical documentation.
* Follow electrical safety procedures and workplace safety standards.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Diploma or B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, or relevant ITI qualification.
* 1–4 years of relevant hands-on experience in electrical maintenance or technical fieldwork.
* Practical knowledge of electrical troubleshooting and fault finding.
* Experience with welding and basic fabrication techniques.
* Understanding of IP addressing, subnet masks, gateways, and basic network connectivity.
* Familiarity with electrical tools, testing instruments, and maintenance procedures.
* Ability to diagnose problems independently and work effectively in a team.
* Willingness to travel to project sites, if required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with industrial equipment, control panels, or automation systems.
* Basic knowledge of PLCs, sensors, controllers, and industrial networking.
* Experience in equipment installation, testing, and commissioning.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹36,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
